name: Domesticated Comedic Angel
description: Upon use, immediately recovers 3 Technique Points for the team.
story:
The "Comedic Angel" used to be quite a dangerous pest. When it's in your line of sight, it won't move a muscle. But the moment it leaves your field of vision, it starts moving at high speed, trying to circle around behind you to absorb your Wishpower.
Nowadays, with this pest nearly extinct, some enterprising pet merchants have bred the "Domesticated Comedic Angel." This Comedic Angel is incredibly small and has a very docile temperament. Owners can sustain it with the Wishpower they naturally metabolize.

"Tired of your pet bouncing off the walls at home? Want to spend some quality quiet time with your pet? Try the 'Domesticated Comedic Angel'! It only bounces around when you can't see it. Out of sight, out of mind!"
